guard: env capture is valid before withheld cells, and dump-then-exit output still reaches attach
why: createRuntime(pty) on Linux is now custodial. childEnvOf waits for handle status() exited before attach so subscribe must replay. Skipping replay or skipping early-buffer accumulation both empty the capture.

mutations.name: M1 skip subscribe output replay
mutations.find: if (early) send(sock, { event: "output", sub, data: Buffer.from(early, "utf8").toString("base64") });
mutations.expectRed: capture is valid (child emitted the sentinel)
mutations.cell: capture is valid (child emitted the sentinel)
mutations.note: Replay skipped. The sentinel must fail first, not the twelve env cells.

mutations.name: M2 skip early-buffer accumulation
mutations.expectRed: capture is valid (child emitted the sentinel)
mutations.cell: capture is valid (child emitted the sentinel)
mutations.note: Same-file positive control: subscribe still sends `early`, but `early` never accumulates, so dump-then-exit attach is empty.
